a_before_b.rationale: Understanding the lack of standardization is not required to use public benchmarks and leaderboards; one can navigate benchmarks and recognize their limitations without first mastering the broader absence of universal standards.

b_before_a.rationale: Using public benchmarks and leaderboards is not required to explain how the absence of universal standards and quality control makes results difficult to compare; the latter is a conceptual explanation independent of hands-on benchmark navigation.
